column4: ~/proj/prompts/reports/SESSION-REVIEW-COVERAGE-2.md item 2. 4 fixed. (1) After a rotation killed between its sweep commit and the dek.key.pending rename, upgrade-aad and rotate-kek deleted the pending file (bare CleanPendingDEK), migrate-provider's re-wrap overwrote it, auth-encryption rotate overwrote it and auth-encryption migrate wrote rows under the retired DEK: every swept row lost. All key writers now take the exclusive lock, run RecoverInterruptedRotation, then Initialize (openKeyWriter/openAuthKeyWriter); internal/encryptionops/review_coverage_test.go:TestKeyWriters_AfterInterruptedRotation_NewDEKSurvives (6 commands). (2) internal/encryption RotateDEKWithSweep removed dek.key.pending when the rename failed after the sweep committed, and on an ambiguous COMMIT error: kept now (errSweepOutcomeUnknown); internal/encryption/rotate_post_commit_failure_test.go. (3) Every command but init generated a new salt+DEK when the key files were missing (wrong cwd, dek_path, unmounted volume); rotate-kek/migrate-provider then reported success on phantom keys and told the operator to change the passphrase/provider. Refused now: TestKeyOps_MissingKeyFiles_RefuseAndCreateNothing (12 commands). (4) shamir-split --out-dir overwrote existing share/commitment files (possibly the live KEK's): O_EXCL, preflight, cleanup, dir fsync; TestShamirSplit_OutDir_RefusesToOverwriteExistingShares. Class guard: internal/encryption/pending_dek_cleanup_guard_test.go:TestCleanPendingDEK_OnlyBehindTheRedoMarker; invariant INV-ENCRYPTION-pending-dek-kept-after-commit. Holding: no key material or passphrase in errors or output (fingerprints only); key files 0600 via securefiles with fsync+dir fsync; admin commands also hold the serverguard presence lock. Not covered: auth-encryption enable still creates keys when missing (an enable/init flavour); the passphrase string copy outlives WipeBytes (Go strings); auth-encryption commands never close their DB handle; the sweep rename is outside the durableRename fault seam
